description: A six channel mixer with a level, a pan trimmer and a mute on each channel, and a stereo output

params.text: Sets the level of that channel, silent fully anticlockwise, unity at its default and twice unity fully clockwise
Places that channel across the stereo field, hard left anticlockwise and hard right clockwise
Silences that channel, one press off and the next on
Sets the level of both mix outputs, silent fully anticlockwise, unity at its default and twice unity fully clockwise

outputs.text: The left side of the mix
The right side of the mix
